en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a central town square bordered by historic multi‑storey townhouses with gabled roofs and dormer windows. Small trees line the open square in orderly rows, and a few pedestrians are visible. Printed red script text at the bottom identifies the place as Ostritz and its marketplace; publisher information is printed in smaller type along the lower edge.
